gripOrHq.title: Arasaka Owns You
gripOrHq.rulesText: Do not play Arasaka Owns You as a normal action; instead, play it when you would suffer enough damage to flatline you. Prevent all of that damage, trash Arasaka Owns You, remove any brain damage you have suffered, and then refresh your hand to its maximum size. Gain [10] and remove all tags, at no cost. You forgo your next four actions, and you forfeit the next 3 agenda points you score.

scoreArea.title: Encryption Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

rig.title: R&D Interface

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.
